name: Network Aviation (white)
description: Network Aviation Group's plainer version on an Air Atlanta Icelandic 747-400F: all white, white fin and engines, and only a large slate-grey 'Network' in plain semibold lowercase (capital N) over the forward main deck; a small 'operated by AIR ATLANTA ICELANDIC' ahead of door 1.

sources.title: TF-AKE Boeing 747-409F Network Aviation Air Atlanta Liege 29.4.25 (CC BY-SA 2.0, Colin Cooke Photo)
sources.note: 747-400F TF-AKE, left side from below, climbing out of Liège, 2025-04-29 (Commons date 2025-06-04). Fitted to shapes/B744.json (doors pinned): the title's ends and height, the small Air Atlanta title, white fin, engines and winglets.

sources.title: TF-AKE Boeing 747-409F Network Aviation op by Atlanta Airlines Liege 25.6.26.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, Colin Cooke Photo)
sources.note: TF-AKE, right side from ahead, at Liège, 2026-06-25 (Commons date 2026-06-24): still all white with the same title over the same stretch, reading normally; the small Air Atlanta title ahead of door 1 on this side too.

titles.style: Plain semibold sans, capital N and lowercase, upright, slate grey, from just behind door 1 to about two thirds of the way to the wing; larger and darker than on the blue version. The same stretch on the right.
Small dark capitals ahead of door 1 under a tiny 'OPERATED BY' and over 'ICELANDIC' (those not drawn).

notes: Flown by Air Atlanta Icelandic (ABD) for Network Aviation Group; tagged in airframes/ABD.json (TF-AKE). TF-AKE was also all white in 2024-10-25 (TF-AKE (25 Oct 2024).jpg). Measured on the left (2025): the title runs 12.4-25.8 m back, as on the blue version, its capital about 1.4 m tall; the left photo is steep from below, so its height is the least certain. Colours by eye.
